description: This file defines the ServerRequestInterface interface within the PSR-7 HTTP message standard, representing an immutable server-side HTTP request with methods for accessing request data such as server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, parsed body, and request attributes.

classes.name: ServerRequestInterface
classes.description: An interface extending RequestInterface, defining methods for accessing server request data such as server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, parsed body, and attributes, emphasizing immutability.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Retrieves data related to the incoming request environment, typically from $_SERVER.

methods.name: getCookieParams
methods.description: Retrieves cookies sent by the client, compatible with $_COOKIE.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified cookies, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified query string arguments.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns normalized upload metadata, with each leaf as an UploadedFileInterface.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified uploaded files.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Retrieves parameters from the request body, such as $_POST or deserialized content.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified body parameters.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes derived from the request, mutable for application-specific data.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a single attribute with an optional default.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specified attribute set.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specified attribute removed.
